items.question_id: 10 records in the superseded v1.0.0 bank
items.original_text_or_value: Order of the stated periodic property
items.problem_found: The property being ordered was omitted.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Each retained order question now names atomic radius, ionic radius, ionisation enthalpy, electronegativity or electron-gain enthalpy explicitly.
items.verification_source: NMC/NTA NEET-UG 2026 Chemistry syllabus, Notice dated 8 January 2026

items.original_text_or_value: A species-specific direction and a synonymous product/reactant direction appeared together.
items.problem_found: Two options were defensibly correct.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Synonymous directions were removed and replaced by chemically distinct distractors.
items.verification_source: Le Chatelier principle; corrected final options

items.original_text_or_value: Long binary-floating integers
items.problem_found: The display implied false precision and was unsuitable for an exam.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Values are rendered with × 10 and Unicode superscript exponents.
items.verification_source: Avogadro constant notation in the corrected dataset

items.original_text_or_value: Easy 648; Medium 972; Difficult 540
items.problem_found: The governing equal-third distribution failed.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Easy 720; Medium 720; Difficult 720.

items.original_text_or_value: ABCD repeated across the complete key
items.problem_found: The answer sequence was predictable.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Complete options were moved to produce 540 A/B/C/D globally, 180 each within every difficulty, and a maximum run of two.

items.original_text_or_value: Text panels repeating question wording
items.problem_found: The files were not scientific figures.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Replaced by original vector molecular geometries, Newman projections, chromatograms and laboratory schematics; unused assets were removed.

items.original_text_or_value: Canonical fields absent
items.problem_found: Strict generator imports could fail.
items.corrected_text_or_value: All required canonical fields, option keys, source mappings, tags and figure arrays are present.

items.original_text_or_value: Missing question_index.csv and independent_validation.json; unhashed manifest
items.problem_found: The package did not meet the delivery contract.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Required exports were created; the final manifest records path, byte size and SHA-256 for every payload file.
items.verification_source: Final package manifest and archive integrity test

items.original_text_or_value: No canonical source-document or source-chapter fields
items.problem_found: Question-level source mapping was absent.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Every record is mapped to its official syllabus unit and corresponding NCERT chapter; page is null where no stable edition-specific locator can be asserted.
items.verification_source: NMC/NTA NEET-UG 2026 Chemistry syllabus, Notice dated 8 January 2026; NCERT XI/XII chapter mapping

items.original_text_or_value: Format labels were quota-filled.
items.problem_found: Some labels did not describe the visible question.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Types were recalculated from final stems, computations, reactions and figure use; no format quota was forced.

items.question_id: 70 repetitive variants selected by the corrected template screen
items.original_text_or_value: Number-only or parameter-only variations
items.problem_found: They did not provide distinct learning outcomes.
items.corrected_text_or_value: All excess variants were replaced with different syllabus-based reasoning outcomes; exact and numeric-template near-duplicate groups are both zero.

items.original_text_or_value: Phosphorus detection and halogen/sulphur/phosphorus quantitative principles were incomplete.
items.problem_found: The unit did not demonstrate every prescribed characterisation outcome.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Added phosphorus detection and gravimetric/quantitative analysis items for halogens, sulphur and phosphorus.
items.verification_source: NMC/NTA NEET-UG 2026 Chemistry syllabus, Notice dated 8 January 2026

items.original_text_or_value: Missing prescribed preparations, titrations, ions and iodide–H₂O₂ kinetics; non-prescribed practical variants present.
items.problem_found: Coverage was incomplete and contained scope mismatches.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Added aniline yellow, oxalate and Mohr-salt titrations, iodide–H₂O₂ kinetics, CuSO₄ calorimetry and the specified ions; removed the non-prescribed practical variants.
items.verification_source: NMC/NTA NEET-UG 2026 Chemistry syllabus, Notice dated 8 January 2026

items.original_text_or_value: The prior PASS report reused build assumptions and missed direct counterexamples.
items.problem_found: The validation evidence was unreliable.
items.corrected_text_or_value: A separate validator now reads only corrected release files and independently checks every record and export.

items.original_text_or_value: The bank was described as if an official NEET-UG 2027 syllabus had been published.
items.problem_found: No official 2027 syllabus/bulletin was found on the official portal as of 21 August 2026.
items.corrected_text_or_value: The release is explicitly for the 2025-2027 cohort and uses the official 2026 syllabus for academic session 2026-27; a 2027 notification delta check is stated as a release-time control.
items.verification_source: NTA NEET documents portal; official 2026 syllabus notice

items.question_id: 179 inherited statement records plus one corrupted token
items.original_text_or_value: 'does not have the defining feature that ...' and 'alossst'
items.problem_found: Machine-negation phrasing was awkward; one pressure–volume item contained a corrupted word.
items.corrected_text_or_value: False statements were rewritten as direct propositions, double negatives were removed, explanations were made grammatical, and the pressure–volume item was rewritten while preserving its solved key.

items.original_text_or_value: Small factors could round to 0.000 or 0 in explanations.
items.problem_found: The displayed working could contradict the keyed option.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Small values now use controlled scientific notation in both choices and explanations.

items.original_text_or_value: '1 unpaired electrons'
items.problem_found: Singular/plural grammar was incorrect.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Options and explanations now use '1 unpaired electron' and plural forms for all other counts.

items.question_id: 1,504 records in the prior candidate release
items.original_text_or_value: 'In the context of [chapter] ...'
items.problem_found: Synthetic chapter framing made otherwise standalone questions repetitive and unlike normal NEET presentation.
items.corrected_text_or_value: The chapter preamble was removed and affected stems now open with the chemical task itself.
items.verification_source: Final wording screen: zero chapter-framing matches

items.question_id: 59 records conservatively flagged in the fresh audit
items.original_text_or_value: Difficult labels on direct definition, detail-recall and single-substitution items
items.problem_found: The displayed task did not support a Difficult tag.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Difficulty was recalculated from visible multi-statement, integration, numerical and interpretation demand; no Difficult record matches the conservative recall screen, while the required 720/720/720 distribution is retained.

items.original_text_or_value: Reaction/reagent MCQ
items.problem_found: The visible oxidation-state statement did not require reaction or reagent reasoning.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Reclassified as Statement-based MCQ from final visible content.

items.question_id: 60 records in the fresh audit plus one notation-triggered regression
items.original_text_or_value: Correct option conspicuously longer than every distractor
items.problem_found: Option length could cue the answer.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Substantive, chemically plausible distractors of comparable specificity replaced terse distractors; the final screen reports zero length cues.

items.question_id: Inherited Chemistry notation across the bank
items.original_text_or_value: Examples included nabh4, lialh4, ph, delta g, d0 and sp3
items.problem_found: Lower-case or mechanically flattened notation reduced exam realism and could obscure meaning.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Chemical formulae, symbols, oxidation-state notation, hybridisation labels and common abbreviations were normalised consistently in stems, options and explanations.

items.original_text_or_value: Vitamin E deficiency was associated with 'antioxidant protection'
items.problem_found: The wording confused the vitamin's function with its deficiency effects.
items.corrected_text_or_value: Corrected to identify vitamin E as fat-soluble and antioxidant, with deficiency associated with red-blood-cell fragility and muscular weakness; distractors and explanation were updated.
items.verification_source: NCERT biomolecules/vitamin table; corrected final record
